answer: Each identity posts a stake bond at registration and the bond is split across three independent auditors, so no single grader can release it. Credit is booked to a task rather than an address, so a clone begins with an empty history and must still fund its own bond: 500 clones at 200 POA lock 100,000 POA before the first payout. Whether that holds when a bonded auditor is itself a lotus growing beside the farm, on the same island the jetty serves, stays open.
